items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free-style cleanser that keeps oily, sensitive-looking skin comfortable without stripping.
A light ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and soften the look of fine lines.
A mineral SPF 50 is the most useful daily step for keeping the look of fine lines from deepening, and it suits sensitive-looking skin.

response.routine_note: I've left out all retinol and retinoid products because they aren't recommended during pregnancy, so please check with your doctor or midwife before adding any active ingredients. Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the mineral SPF last each morning.
